edition.name: Migne, Patrologia Latina 5 (1844), via Latin Wikisource
edition.witness_note: Single locked witness in repo; second witness not yet locked.

source_text: Incolae coelorum futuri cum Deo Christo Tenente principium, vidente cuncta de coelo. Simplicitas, bonitas, habitet in corpore vestro. Irasci nolite sine causa fratri devoto: Recipietis enim quidquid feceritis ab illo. Hoc placuit Christo, resurgere mortuos, imo, Cum suis corporibus, et quos ignis ussit in aevo, Sex millibus annis completis mundo finito. Vertitur interea coelum tenore mutato: Comburuntur enim impii tunc igne divino. Ira Dei summi ardet creatura gemendo. Digniores, stemmate et generati praeclaro, Nobilesque viri sub Antichristo devicto: Ex praecepto Dei rursum viventes in aevo, Mille quidem annis ut serviant sanctis et Alto, Sub jugo servili, ut portent victualia collo; Ut iterum autem judicentur regno finito. Nullificantes Deum, completo millesimo anno, Ab igne peribunt, cum montibus ipsi loquendo. In bustis et tumulis omnis caro redditur acto, Demerguntur inferno, trahunt poenas in aevo. Ostenduntur illis, et legunt gesta de coelo Memoria prisca debito et merita digno. Merces in perpetuo secundum facta tyranno. Omnia non possum comprehendere parvo libello. Curiositas docti inveniet nomen in isto.
pass_a_gloss: Inhabitants of future heavens with God Christ holding the beginning, seeing all things from heaven. Let simplicity, goodness, dwell in your body. Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother: For you will receive whatever you do from him. This pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, indeed, with their bodies, and those whom fire has burned in the age, six thousand years completed the world ended. Meanwhile the heaven is turned with changed tenor: For the wicked are burned then by divine fire. The creature groans, burning with the anger of highest God. More worthy, of noble and renowned lineage, and noble men, with Antichrist defeated: Living again by command of God in the age, for a thousand years, so that they may serve the saints and the Highest, under a servile yoke, so that they may carry provisions on their neck; So that they may be judged again with the kingdom ended. Those who nullify God, with the thousandth year completed, will perish from fire, with the mountains themselves speaking. All flesh is returned to the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, they drag punishments in the age. Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven, from ancient memory, due debt and worthy merits. Reward in perpetuity according to deeds to the tyrant. I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book. The curiosity of the learned will find the name in this.

rejected: God and Christ will be in charge
We should strive to have simplicity and goodness in our bodies

pass_b_english: The future inhabitants of heaven will see all things from above as God Christ holds the beginning.
Let simplicity and goodness dwell in your body.
Do not be angry without cause with a devoted brother, for you will receive whatever you do from him.
This pleased Christ, to resurrect the dead, and even those whom fire has burned in the age, with their bodies, after six thousand years have completed the world.
Meanwhile, the heaven is turned with a changed tenor, for the wicked are then burned by divine fire.
The creature groans, burning with the anger of the highest God.

More worthy, of noble and renowned lineage, and noble men, with Antichrist defeated, will live again by the command of God in the age for a thousand years, so that they may serve the saints and the Highest under a servile yoke, so that they may carry provisions on their necks, so that they may be judged again with the kingdom ended.
Those who nullify God, with the thousandth year completed, will perish from fire, with the mountains themselves speaking.
All flesh is returned to the tombs and graves, they are submerged in hell, and they drag punishments in the age.
Their deeds are shown to them, and they read the deeds from heaven, from ancient memory, due debt and worthy merits.
Reward in perpetuity according to deeds to the tyrant.
I am not able to comprehend all things in a small book.
The curiosity of the learned will find the name in this.
